finding.summary: DOCX table-cell `w:fill` still interpolates an untrusted color string unescaped — bypasses the XML escaping this delta added to run properties
finding.evidence: The delta closes attribute injection for `<w:color>` / `<w:shd w:fill>` inside `buildRunPropertiesXml` (packages/docs/src/export/docx-style-map.ts:78-84). The very same OOXML attribute is written for table cells without any escaping: `packages/docs/src/export/docx-exporter.ts:309-311` — `const hex = cell.style.backgroundColor.replace('#', ''); tcPrParts.push(`<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="${hex}"/>`)`. `CellStyle.backgroundColor` is a plain `string` (packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:441) fed from untrusted input: the DOCX importer builds it verbatim from the source file's `w:fill` attribute (`packages/docs/src/import/docx-style-map.ts:174`: `result.backgroundColor = `#${fill}``, and docx-importer.ts:431 copies it onto the cell), and HTML paste writes `td.style.backgroundColor` (packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:417). Import → export round-trip therefore emits e.g. `w:fill="a"/><w:b"`, breaking the element / injecting OOXML in the exported document (also reachable from the CLI export path, packages/cli/src/docs/docx-export.ts). Fix belongs on docx-exporter.ts:310 (reuse `escapeXmlAttr`, ideally exported from docx-style-map.ts).

verdict.reason: The claimed unescaped interpolation does not exist in the current source. packages/docs/src/export/docx-exporter.ts:319-322 reads `const cellFill = toDocxHexColor(cell.style.backgroundColor); if (cellFill) tcPrParts.push(`<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="${cellFill}"/>`)` — i.e. the table-cell sink already routes through the same ST_HexColor normalizer as the run-level sink (docx-style-map.ts:125-128), imported at docx-exporter.ts:7. A repo-wide grep for `replace('#'` finds the finding's quoted line (`const hex = cell.style.backgroundColor.replace('#', '')`) only in an archived task document (docs/tasks/archive/2026/04/20260410-docx-import-export-todo.md:2407), never in packages/docs/src/export/. toDocxHexColor (docx-style-map.ts:53-75) returns only [0-9A-F]{6} or undefined on every branch (6-hex, 3-nibble expansion, 8-hex sliced, rgb/rgba channels clamped and hex-formatted), so no quote or angle bracket can reach the attribute, and non-hex values drop the attribute instead. The exact adversarial payload in the finding is unit-tested as returning undefined at packages/docs/test/export/docx-style-map.test.ts:127. The untrusted upstreams cited (docx importer's `#${fill}`, clipboard CSS) and the CLI export path all reach this same normalized sink, so there is no bypassing call site — the blast-radius premise of a second unprotected sink is false.
